caption: The drawing depicts a Victorian-style bedroom filled with a variety of objects, primarily in muted pastel colors and earth tones. On the left side, there is a brass or iron bed with intricate designs, covered with a white and floral-patterned bedspread and pillows. Beside the bed is a matching wooden nightstand holding a large floral washbasin and pitcher set, along with other smaller ceramic pieces. In front of the bed, a dark-colored table displays two ornate porcelain pitchers and a pair of shoes. The walls are adorned with striped lavender and gray wallpaper with floral accents, and above the bed, a taxidermied animal skin with a snarling face is mounted. A large, oval standing mirror on a wooden dresser sits next to a window with lace curtains, and the dresser top holds a blue jug and other small items. A chandelier and hanging lamps, each with intricate golden designs, hang from the ceiling in the middle of the room. At the center, a circular braided rug of blue, green, and purple tones occupies the floor, supporting a wooden rocking chair, a small circular stool with fringe, and a large floral arrangement in front of a fireplace or decorative mantel. To the right, a round table holds a red oil lamp, a stack of letters, books, and correspondence, and a deck of cards. Three chairs of different styles—a wooden side chair, a low red-upholstered ottoman, and a sewing box on legs—are positioned nearby. Toward the back, a staircase ascends against the wall, near an ornately carved, gold-trimmed wardrobe with an oval mirror inset displaying a painted child’s portrait. A sign above the wardrobe reads "What is home without a mother?" framed in decorative script. The overall ambiance is one of crowded Victorian decor, with household and personal objects covering almost every surface in the room.
title: Rooming House Bed-Living Room
